function read(value: object | string): number {
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    const preserved: object = value;
    return Object.keys(preserved).length;
  }
  return value.length;
}
function negate(value: object | string | null): number {
  if (typeof value !== 'object') return value.length;
  return value === null ? -1 : read(value);
}
function call(value: object): unknown {
  return typeof value === 'function' ? value() : undefined;
}
function readDynamic(value: any): unknown {
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    const acceptsNumber: number = value;
    const acceptsNull: null = value;
    return value?.get() ?? acceptsNull ?? acceptsNumber;
  }
  if (typeof value === 'function') return value();
  if (typeof value === 'string') return value.length;
  return value;
}
console.log(read('ready'), read({ first: 1, second: 2 }), negate(null), negate('a'), call(() => 5));
console.log(readDynamic({ get: () => 'read' }), readDynamic(null), readDynamic(() => 7), readDynamic('go'));
